summary: Frontend-only testing of Admin Events View page redesign. Successfully verified mobile-responsive layout with card-based view on mobile (375px) and table layout on desktop (1920px). All 10 requested features tested and working.
critical_code_review_comments: The AdminEventsView.js component is well-structured at 604 lines with clean responsive design using Tailwind CSS breakpoints (lg:hidden, hidden lg:block).

All required data-testid attributes are present for testing: admin-events-view, events-table-desktop, events-cards-mobile, events-tab-upcoming, events-tab-past, events-search-input, events-filter-toggle, events-select-all, events-bulk-actions, etc.
Event cards include type badges with color coding (TYPE_COLORS), status badges (STATUS_STYLES), date/time/location display as requested.
seed_data_creation: None - Used existing 25 events in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Events View redesign complete and tested. Navigation path: Login -> Admin Portal (sidebar) -> League Management tab -> Events sub-tab. On mobile, use bottom nav 'Admin' link.
